title: Getting here
body:
## By car
Parking is signposted from the edge of the village.

## Public transport
Shuttle bus from the train station, hourly until 2 am.

title: Camping
body: The camping meadow opens on Friday at noon. Please no glass bottles - campfires only at the marked spots.

title: FAQ
body:
## Can I bring my own drinks?
Not onto the festival grounds; on the campsite yes (no glass).

## Is there drinking water?
Yes, free of charge at the info point and the restrooms.
